Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
Is someone riding it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Of course people ride it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's stopped.
Right on that floor, too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To protect my beloved, the blade of justice strikes the enemy!
With red blood burning crimson, that is a man's way of life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I make my entrance! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aaah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You should have Gabon examine you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I am health itself!
I'm not so feeble that I'd fall ill!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm pretty confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It's like enka.
Fain: "Isn't it? That last part, especially!
It thrills even me when I say it."
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Perhaps something like 'a song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? So it's a song that resonates
directly with the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation is just that
wonderful!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice is also to protect the people dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. People dear to you, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep away..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've resolved in my heart to love only one woman.
But I also bear the noble and supreme
duty of protecting the princess. I can't forsake either loyalty or love.
Ah... What an ordeal! This is a knight's destiny!
Then I shall press on! To fight fate!
No, wait. But wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything, my master said.
Does that mean I must see one choice or the other through?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! This is all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have had to suffer
like this...
Wait! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their scheme against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess
all at the same time?
No, but that would go against my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it rough too."
Touya: "Well, he seems to find it fulfilling in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Ymir: "Oh, Mr. Touya. Is something wrong?"
Touya: "Nothing, really..."
Ymir: "Heh heh heh. Can't settle down?"
Touya: "Yeah. I don't like planes much."
Ymir: "Oh... I'm sorry."
Touya: "It's fine. Anyway, is this thing going fast?"
Ai: "You can't tell because we're so high up.
We're at Mach 0.92 right now."
Touya: "Near the speed of sound...? In something this huge?"
Celica: "Oh, right, Ai. What do you think of the Liebhofen?
Don't you think it's cool?"
Ai: "Yeah. It's pretty impressive, isn't it?"
Celica: "Good. I'm glad you like it."
Ai: "Hey, Celica. Doesn't it transform?
If it transformed into a Spirit Mech, it'd be unbeatable!
That's what I think, anyway."
Celica: "Huh...? Oh! I could have done that...
How could I have failed to think of that?
That was careless of me.
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:16:03><FC:02:3E><FC:04:3C:1C:02><FC:01:3E><FC:04:3C:1C:F0>Oh, but perhaps it isn't too late..."
Ymir: "Hey?!"
Celica: "Of course I'm joking.
I'd never do anything like that...
Hahaha."
Touya: '...Her eyes are serious.'
Ymir: 'Y-Yes. I doubt she'd really do it,
but we'd better keep an eye on her.'
Ai: "Then let's get a drawing of the finished design..."
Ai: "Owww!"
Touya: "Don't you go stirring up strange ideas too!"
Yamato: "Whoa! What's with all these wires?!"
Touya: "This bit looks like some kind of machine..."
Ymir: "...Oh, Mr. Touya."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Ymir: "We found a fault in the control system earlier,
so I was investigating it."
Yamato: "Did you do all this by yourself?"
Ymir: "Yes. I'm not good at heavy lifting,
so it was a bit difficult."
Touya: "Is it serious?"
Ymir: "It's manageable as long as we pay attention,
but there is a possibility of malfunction...
Oh, but don't worry.
I've already finished correcting the system."
Touya: "Then all that's left is to put these cables and this board-like thing
back where they were?"
Ymir: "Yes."
Yamato: "Touya, we shouldn't get in her way. Let's go."
Touya: "..."
I'll help.
Well then, we'll be going.
Ymir: "Huh?"
Touya: "It's a lot to do alone, isn't it? I'll help."
Ymir: "Oh, you don't need to."
Touya: "Even I can carry things.
Besides, you said heavy lifting wasn't your thing, right? Just tell me what to do."
Ymir: "O-Oh, yes... Thank you."
Touya: "It's fine. Let's get it finished."
Ymir: "Yes."
Touya: "...All right."
Ymir: "Thank you. That was a great help.
It really is quicker when a man is here."
Touya: "I'm surprised you were going to do all that alone."
Ymir: "Everyone's busy..."
Touya: "That doesn't mean you need to work so hard
all by yourself."
Ymir: "You're right. I'll be more careful from now on."
Touya: "Well, we'll be going."
Ymir: "Oh, yes. See you, then."
Ymir: "Oh, Mr. Touya. What is it?"
Touya: "Nothing. I don't really need anything, but..."
Ymir: "I see."
Yamato: "Honestly, don't disturb her when you don't need anything.
Sorry to bother you."
Ymir: "Oh, Mr. Touya. What is it?
Another question?"
Touya: "Yeah. If you're busy, I can come back later..."
Ymir: "No, it's fine.
What is it?"
Touya: "You said you weren't comfortable
being praised or admired, right?
I was curious about what you started to say back then, Ymir..."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Is it hard to talk about?"
Ymir: "...It's not a very nice story..."
Touya: "That's all right."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "............At some point,
the expectant looks everyone gave me
began to hurt."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "Of course, I didn't run away because of that.
I worked hard to meet their expectations each time."
Yamato: "You're a hard worker."
Ymir: "...No. I was just afraid of the disappointment
in their eyes when I failed to meet their expectations.
I was only afraid of getting hurt..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "See? It's not a very nice story, is it?"
Touya: "But it's because you worked hard, Ymir,
that we have today's Ymir and the Spirit Mechs, right?
Besides, no one wants to be disliked."
Ymir: "..."
Touya: "Everyone's afraid of getting hurt.
And, Ymir, the hard work you've put in to get this far
is a fact no one can deny."
Ymir: "Mr. Touya..."
Touya: "Oh, I'm sounding a bit high and mighty, aren't I?
Sorry."
Ymir: "No. Thank you.
I'm glad I told you, Mr. Touya."
Touya: "R-Really?"
Ymir: "Yes. You're kind."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Aww, you're blushing! How cute!"
Touya: "Shut up."
Ymir: "Heh heh heh."
Touya: "Th-That's all I wanted to ask. See you."
Yamato: "Oh, h-hey! Wait for me!"
Ymir: "I'm sorry."
Touya: "I see..."
Ymir: "It's not the sort of thing to tell other people... I'm sorry."
Touya: "Okay. Sorry to bother you. See you."
